title: IdentityResponse
description: Response with details personal information related to the owner of the connection's account

id.description: The ID of the identity to retrieve

itemId.description: Identifier of the item linked to the identity

taxNumber.description: The tax ID (CNPJ) associated with the business account

document.description: Primary document that identifies the owner

fullName.description: Name of the owner of the account

establishmentName.description: Name of the establishment (only for PAYMENT_ACCOUNT connectors)

companyName.description: For business connector, the name of the business

phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers related to the account

emails.description: List of email addresses related to the account

addresses.description: List of addresses related to the account

relations.description: List of names related to the account

investorProfile.description: Is a rating that indicates the investor personality and motivation for investing

qualifications.description: Information that allows understanding since when the consulted person has been a client of the institution, as well as an indicator of the products and services they currently consume and their representatives

occupationDescription.description: Free-text occupation description. When occupationCode is RECEITA_FEDERAL or CBO it holds the standardized list code; when OUTRO it describes the occupation in cases where the institution does not follow the Receita Federal nor the CBO list

date.description: Date when the income was informed
Reference date of the patrimony. Returned on the business path of Open Finance, where the source field is a full date rather than just a year

economicActivities.description: List of CNAE codes describing the economic activities of the business (Brazilian National Classification of Economic Activities). Only one entry per response should be marked as main

startDate.description: Date when the relationship with the institution started

productsServicesType.description: List of products and services that the client consumes

productsServicesTypeAdditionalInfo.description: Additional info about the products and services. Populated when productsServicesType includes 'OUTROS'

type.description: Type of relationship with the client. Legal representative — natural person who represents the entity and is named in its incorporation document. Procurator — any person authorized in writing to represent the client in some business

cpfNumber.description: CPF of the procurator. For business links this field may hold a CPF or a CNPJ (kept for backward compatibility — prefer documentNumber + documentType)

documentNumber.description: Document number of the procurator (CPF or CNPJ). Mirrors cpfNumber and is the canonical value to read

documentType.description: Type of document carried by documentNumber

civilName.description: Civil name of the procurator. For business procurators, may hold the company name

socialName.description: Social name of the procurator, if any

procurators.description: List of procurators of the client

accounts.description: List of accounts of the client with valid consent. Only accounts that have explicit user consent are returned.

portabilitiesReceived.description: Salary portabilities received by the institution from the client's previous paycheck banks (banco-folha). PF-only field

paychecksBankLink.description: Paycheck-bank (banco-folha) links to employers, active or formerly active. PF-only field

financialRelationships.description: Information that allows institutions to assess, evaluate, characterize, and classify the client with the purpose of understanding their risk profile and their economic-financial capacity

socialName.description: Social name of the natural person, if any (the name by which travestis and transsexuals recognize themselves and are recognized in their community). PF-only field

sex.description: Sex of the natural person. PF-only field

maritalStatus.description: Marital status of the natural person. PF-only field

nationality.description: Nationality of the natural person. PF-only field

otherDocuments.description: List of other identification documents the natural person holds. PF-only field

passport.description: Passport metadata for the natural person. PF-only field

incorporationDate.description: Date the business was incorporated. PJ-only field

parties.description: Partners and administrators of the business. PJ-only field

businessOtherDocuments.description: List of additional documents for businesses headquartered abroad and not required to register a CNPJ. PJ-only field

companiesCnpj.description: CNPJs of the financial institutions responsible for the customer cadastro. Numbers only, no mask

createdAt.description: Date when the identity was first ingested by Pluggy.

updatedAt.description: Date of the last update of the identity data.

Address.description: The address object contains data related to an specific owner's location.

fullAddress.description: Full address using all components available

primaryAddress.description: Primary address, stret name and street number

type.description: Type of address, Personal or Work

additionalInfo.description: Additional address information such as apartment number, complement, or other details

district.description: District / neighborhood (bairro) — a community or region within a city or municipality based on geographic subdivisions

ibgeTownCode.description: IBGE municipality code (7 digits). The IBGE table associates each Brazilian municipality with a 7-digit code; the first two digits identify the Federation Unit

countryCode.description: Country code in alpha3 ISO-3166 format (e.g. 'BRA')

BusinessOtherDocument.description: Additional document for businesses headquartered abroad and not required to register a CNPJ

country.description: Issuing country in alpha3 ISO-3166 format

BusinessParty.description: Partner or administrator of a business. Partners with less than 25% shareholding may be omitted by the institution

type.description: Role of the party in the business. Administrator — runs the day-to-day, signs documents and legally responds for the entity. Partner — holds capital but may not be involved in administrative activities

personType.description: Whether the party is a natural person or a legal entity

documentType.description: Type of the party's identification document

documentNumber.description: Number of the identification document (digits and check digit, if any)

documentCountry.description: Issuing country of the document, alpha3 ISO-3166

documentAdditionalInfo.description: Free-text complement when the document carries identification info that doesn't fit the other fields

civilName.description: Civil name of the party. Required when personType is NATURAL_PERSON

socialName.description: Social name of the natural-person party, if any

companyName.description: Company name of the party. Required when personType is LEGAL_ENTITY

tradeName.description: Trade name of the legal-entity party, if any

shareholding.description: Shareholding fraction between 0 and 1 (e.g. 0.51 represents 51%, 1 represents 100%). Required when type is PARTNER and the shareholding is 25% or higher

EconomicActivity.description: CNAE code describing one of the business's economic activities. Only one entry per response should be marked as main

code.description: CNAE code (7 digits, including leading zeros). Follows the CNAE-Subclasse 2.3 classification

isMain.description: Whether this is the main economic activity (true) or a secondary one (false). Only one item per response should be true

Email.description: The email object contains emails associated with the owner of the account

value.description: The full email of the person.

GeographicCoordinates.description: Geographic coordinates in decimal degrees, WGS84 reference system

IdentityRelation.description: The relation object contains name and relation to the owner of the account

type.description: Type of relation: Father, Mother or Spouse

name.description: The full name of the person

InformedRevenue.description: Revenue (faturamento) informed by the business — the business equivalent of informedIncome

frequency.description: Frequency or period of the informed revenue

frequencyAdditionalInfo.description: Free-text complement to the frequency. Populated when frequency is OTHER

MaritalStatus.description: Marital status of the natural person

additionalInfo.description: Free-text complement. Populated when code is OTHER

hasBrazilianNationality.description: Whether the client has Brazilian nationality

otherNationalities.description: Other nationalities held by the client, if any

countryCode.description: Country code in alpha3 ISO-3166 format

NationalityDocument.description: Supporting document for a non-Brazilian nationality

type.description: Document type (free text). Required when the nationality is not Brazilian

number.description: Document number. Required when the nationality is not Brazilian

OtherDocument.description: Other identification document held by the natural person. Brazilian acronyms are kept verbatim; OTHER covers any other type

typeAdditionalInfo.description: Free-text complement. Populated when type is OTHER

checkDigit.description: Check digit of the document, if it has one

additionalInfo.description: Free-text complement, used to record the issuing authority (e.g. 'SSP/SP') when relevant

Passport.description: Passport metadata for the natural person. Applies when the client is a non-resident not required to register a CPF

country.description: Issuing country in alpha3 ISO-3166 format

PaycheckBankLink.description: Paycheck-bank (banco-folha) link to an employer, active or formerly active. Old employers may not have closed the link, so an entry doesn't guarantee the listed employer is the current one

employerName.description: Employer name as registered when the paycheck account was opened. When the employer is a legal entity, this is the company name

employerDocument.description: Employer document (CPF or CNPJ) as registered when the paycheck account was opened

paycheckBankCnpj.description: CNPJ of the institution contracted to provide the paycheck service (banco-folha)

paycheckBankIspb.description: ISPB of the institution contracted to provide the paycheck service

accountOpeningDate.description: Date the paycheck account was opened

PhoneNumber.description: The phone number object contains data related to contact information.

type.description: Type of phone number: personal, work or residencial

countryCallingCode.description: International dialing code (DDI). Populated when different from '55'

areaCode.description: Area code (DDD) of the client's phone

extension.description: Extension number, when part of the phone identification

additionalInfo.description: Additional info related to the source phone type. Populated when the source type at the institution does not fit the standard categories

PortabilityReceived.description: Salary portability received by the institution from a previous paycheck bank (banco-folha). Approved requests only — a portability is never explicitly closed, so an entry doesn't guarantee an active link with the listed paycheck bank

employerName.description: Employer name as received in the portability message. When the employer is a legal entity, this is the company name

employerDocument.description: Employer document (CPF or CNPJ) as received in the portability message

paycheckBankDetainerCnpj.description: CNPJ of the bank that holds the paycheck account (banco-folha) as received in the portability message

paycheckBankDetainerIspb.description: ISPB of the bank that holds the paycheck account as received in the portability message
